papers.title: A unified probabilistic defect-based fatigue modelling approach to account for surface and bulk defects in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys and defect characterisation
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured metals are often affected by material inhomogeneities across multiple length scales. Geometrical inhomogeneities, as well as non-metallic inclusions — commonly referred to as defects — can significantly impair the fatigue performance of the fabricated material, especially in the absence of further post-processing. Therefore, accounting for these defects is essential for a proper assessment of the material’s structural integrity. Fracture Mechanics-based approaches have proven effective in addressing bulk and sub-surface defects; however, a consensus has yet to be reached on the most effective method for addressing surface geometrical inhomogeneities (e.g., surface roughness). This work presents the effectiveness of a generalised defect-based model capable of accounting for bulk, sub-surface, and surface defect (roughness) effects on the fatigue endurance limit. The proposed model is calibrated on a detailed experimental fatigue characterisation study of a Ti-6Al-4V alloy manufactured through two different techniques, i.e., Electron Beam Melting (EBM) and Selective Laser Melting (SLM). To achieve varied defect characteristics and quantitatively assess their influence on fatigue, the additively manufactured materials were subjected to different combinations of post-processing (e.g., Hot Isostatic Pressing, Vacuum Heat Treatment). Defect distributions were investigated using the non-destructive lab-based Computed Tomography (CT), and further data analysis was conducted by exploiting the Extreme Value Statistics (EVS) theory. The approach was effective across all studied material conditions, providing a probabilistic assessment of fatigue failure performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究Ti-6Al-4V合金的后处理（热等静压、真空热处理）对疲劳性能的影响，符合L2方向要求。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not focus on a single post-processing route's effect on microstructure or tensile properties; instead, it presents a defect-based fatigue model calibrated on multiple post-processing conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷严重影响疲劳性能，需要统一模型来评估表面和内部缺陷的影响。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于概率断裂力学的缺陷模型，结合CT和极值统计，并使用不同后处理条件进行校准。
summary_zh.result: 模型能有效预测不同后处理状态下Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳极限，提供概率失效评估。
summary_zh.validation: 通过EBM和SLM两种工艺制造的Ti-6Al-4V在不同后处理后的疲劳实验数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: The fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V is severely degraded by defects, necessitating a unified model to account for both surface and bulk defects under various post-processing conditions.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic defect-based fatigue model integrating fracture mechanics, computed tomography, and extreme value statistics is calibrated on Ti-6Al-4V specimens subjected to hot isostatic pressing, vacuum heat treatment, and as-built conditions.
summary_en.result: The proposed model effectively predicts the fatigue endurance limit across all studied material states, providing a probabilistic assessment of failure.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against an extensive experimental fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V manufactured by electron beam melting and selective laser melting with different post-processing treatments.

papers.title: Virtual and Physical Prototyping Data statement
papers.abstract: This dataset contains all figures associated with the manuscript on chamber-free laser wire directed energy deposition (LW-DED) of Ti-6Al-4V using morphing shield technology (MST). The uploaded figures include CFD simulations of gas flow behavior under different shielding configurations, experimental build results for thin-wall and large-scale structures, optical and microstructural observations, and mechanical characterization including hardness distributions.The dataset supports the validation of localized inert gas shielding in open-atmosphere conditions and provides visual evidence of process stability, oxidation control, and structure–property relationships. Figures include comparisons between conventional outer shielding and morphing shield configurations, as well as builds performed with and without real-time melt control.These images are provided to enhance transparency, reproducibility, and further analysis of the reported results.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该数据集提供了Ti-6Al-4V增材制造（LW-DED）的硬度分布等力学表征，但缺乏疲劳性能数据，仅作为辅助资料。
llm.why_not_core: This is a dataset of figures supporting a separate manuscript; it does not present standalone mechanical/fatigue characterization or modeling, and contains no fatigue data.

summary_zh.motivation: 提供激光导线材定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V数据的可视化支持。
summary_zh.method: 包含CFD模拟、实验构建、微观结构和硬度分布的数据集。
summary_zh.result: 展示了不同屏蔽配置下的气体流动、构建质量和结构-性能关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验构建和硬度测试验证局部惰性气体屏蔽效果。

summary_en.motivation: This dataset provides visual evidence to support the validation of localized inert gas shielding in open-atmosphere LW-DED of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: The dataset includes CFD simulations, experimental builds, microstructural observations, and hardness distributions.
summary_en.result: Gas flow behavior, process stability, oxidation control, and structure–property relationships are documented for different shielding configurations.
summary_en.validation: Experimental builds and hardness measurements validate the effectiveness of morphing shield technology.
